validate.title: Check the profiles file
validate.description:
{report}

Phone location is not always reliable. In stations, tunnels, or with battery saving on, your position can be late or wrong. Location only helps the companion. It never hides a warning about your train.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Every alert is also sent as signed JSON to these URLs. Saving a change first sends each URL a signed loud and a signed silent test, which it must accept. Your phone stays the proof that alerts arrive.

data_description.webhook_urls: One URL per line. Leave empty to turn webhooks off.
data_description.webhook_secret: At least 16 characters. Give the same secret to the receiver.
data_description.webhook_token: Optional. Only for receivers that want a token, such as OpenClaw. Sent to every URL.

error.bad_webhook_url: Each line must be an http or https URL without a user name or password.
error.weak_webhook_secret: The secret must be at least 16 characters, or a valid whsec_ value.
error.weak_webhook_token: The token must be at least 16 characters of plain ASCII, without spaces.
error.webhook_test_failed: A test send was not accepted: {failed}. Check the receiver, its secret and its token, then save again.
